meetings_page_path_patterns: /?s=agenda (WordPress's own built-in search) is the one that actually works -- WO-176 (2026-09-10) measured it live on 600 real no-platform-link governments: 175 fingerprinted as WordPress (by far the most common single family in the sample, ahead of CivicPlus+Revize combined). The full generic path/feed list (sitemap first, then /calendar,/events,/minutes,/agendas,/archive,/feed/,...) found a real listing on 38/175 (21.7%) before ever reaching a WordPress-specific path. A SEPARATE follow-up run tried /?s=agenda plus two path guesses (/category/agendas, /category/meetings) on exactly the 137 WordPress sites the generic list found NOTHING on: /?s=agenda alone found 35 more real listings (25.5% of those 137, spot-checked against real WordPress post/category markup, not just the word 'agenda' echoed back by the search page) -- the two /category/ guesses found zero. Combined real hit rate across both passes: 73/175 = 41.7%. /category/agendas and /category/meetings are NOT confirmed and should not be relied on
